observations.observation: DataFusion pinned to 53.1.0; Arrow 58 and Iceberg 0.10.1. This is not a selected future compatibility tuple.
Job inputs include exact native-table and Iceberg-pin forms.
Job steps are SQL/components, with no Substrait variant or stable managed operation ID.
Returned failure retains completed outputs; the catalog-injected job has no lifecycle store.
SQL uses the budgeted context, read-only statement restrictions, and immutable-function validation.
Admitted managed work moves into an owned task; a lost caller wait does not establish cancellation.
Built-in routine validator identity is separate from retained computation, not an external evaluator acceptance API.
Material processing and routine validation have distinct phase keys.
Guarded native selection checks authority/dependencies; accepting external quality evidence would be new work.
Native snapshot and dataset-version identities preserve interpretation; retained reference metadata alone does not promise payload availability.
Native object metadata verification uses BLAKE3.
Actual exported files separately report SHA-256 and MD5.
Remote operation support is narrower than local; capabilities must name operation/backend pairs.
Existing routine-validation evidence explicitly does not establish arbitrary external validator support.
